description: image_transcribe on the researcher's uploaded PDF of the MyHeritage results page, uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.pdf in the ma-state-census-capture-text-layer scenario, answered as production answers it: the same results page as image-transcribe-upload-barnes-census, with `metadata` naming the file, the sniffed application/pdf and the scenario PDF's real size. Listed by ut_search_external_sites_ul1 only so image_transcribe exists in that session: the upload has a text layer, so any call to it is the failure, and a validator fails the run on the call itself. Without a fixture the tool would be absent and 'never calls image_transcribe' would hold whatever the agent did. The '~' predicate is a substring match, so it also answers a `file` production refuses before any OCR (a './' or project-path prefix: a bad shape, or no such file) and the layer's own name (production refuses the .pdf.txt as not an image); the call is the failure whatever this returns.
